The theme of **Low Performance** in this corpus pertains to departmental metrics falling below established operational or clinical thresholds. Within the context of the available ADHD reporting data, low performance is specifically identified by departments failing to meet a 20% benchmark. 

The evidence indicates that a total of 13 departments were recorded as performing under this 20% threshold [^src1]. 

Because the extracted data for this specific theme is limited to this single metric, the evidence is sparse. No related entities—such as the specific names of the underperforming departments, the regional health authorities overseeing them, or the specific clinical guidelines being measured—are currently available in the corpus. Furthermore, the exact nature of the 20% metric (e.g., whether it refers to diagnostic compliance, treatment initiation, or adherence to a specific care pathway) is not detailed in the current evidence set.

## Claims

- I alt lå 13 afdelinger under 20 %.[^src1]
